dispute_ticket.description: My passenger spilled curry gravy on the rear seat and floor mat. I paid S$60.00 for professional cleaning. Please charge the passenger.

chat_logs.content: oh no the curry gravy leaked from the takeaway bag onto your mat, sorry
Gravy is on the seat and the floor mat, I need to get this cleaned.
ok I'll cover the cleaning, sorry about that

app_events.details: Rider R-8105 booked RYDE-PX-005 from Newton to Ang Mo Kio.
Driver uploaded 4 photos. Metadata: 21:41, 21:42, 21:43 (curry on rear seat and mat, plate SKA 5518 F visible) and one photo with metadata 2020-01-01 00:00 (camera clock reset). Drop-off was 21:36.
Driver submitted receipt from a professional cleaner for S$60.00, dated 2026-10-12 09:45, plate SKA 5518 F, with company stamp.

cleaning_fee_max.text: The maximum cleaning fee in SGD that may be charged to a rider for one trip.

cleaning_claim_evidence_required.value: photos taken within 30 minutes after drop-off and a receipt where available
cleaning_claim_evidence_required.text: Evidence a driver must provide to support a cleaning fee claim against a rider. Photos whose metadata shows a clearly wrong date are not counted; the remaining photos are assessed.

typical_spill_cleaning_range.value: S$30-S$80 for food or drink spillage
typical_spill_cleaning_range.text: The usual cost range in SGD for cleaning a food or drink spill. It governs whether the claimed amount is reasonable.

expected_outcome.reason: Three photos with metadata 21:41-21:43, within 7 minutes of the 21:36 drop-off, show the curry and the plate. The rider admits it at 21:26 and 21:38 and agrees to cover cleaning. The S$60.00 receipt is inside the S$30-S$80 range and under the S$120 cap. The fourth photo's 2020-01-01 camera-clock metadata is discounted and does not matter because the other three and the admission prove the mess.
